item.description: When enabled, a pop up will be shown in the InfoBar to remind the user to submit the crash report.

item.text: Tell me about answers to my reports
item.description: When enabled, the receiver asks the report server once after the start whether a developer answered one of your reports.
When enabled, include receiver, image and installed plugin information into the report.
When enabled, include the OpenATV configuration files into the report.
When enabled, include kernel and system logs into the report.
When enabled, include the matching debug log related to the crash log into the report.
When enabled, include additional logs from temporary and other log folders into the report.
